overview.title: The essay workstream — what this is
overview.what: the Grammar of Meaning essays — field notes on how meaning gets made, written in the first person but about what the archive shows, not about the self
body:
The public-facing writing of the project: essays that take one cross-tradition observation, one connection between two traditions, or one methodology decision, and render it for a reader. The voice is first-person about the third — the I is present for intimacy, but its subject is what is being seen in the archive, not the seer. The register is curatorial (Public Domain Review lineage), not personal-essay.

Two homes: the Grammar of Meaning Substack (the published source of truth) mirrored to essays.html, and the seed backlog that feeds it.

pipeline.title: How an essay gets made — the /grammar pipeline
pipeline.what: input → transform → output, eight steps; the machines are the workshop, the writer makes the thing
body:
An essay is made in the space between, three times (see essay-engine): a reader meets the sources and a seed is born; the engines meet the archive and raw material comes back; the writer meets the drafts and, pass after pass, the essay becomes itself.

  1. Read — the voice guide + a canon essay for sentence-level reference.
  2. Gather substrate — a structured archive harvest (six buckets) into a reference pack; cast wide, then a parity fan-out + frame sweep so the sources aren't the expected canon.
  3. Pick the series slot — Convergence Report / Field Note / Same Mechanism / Method in Public.
  4. One-thesis + one-paradigm walk-away — a single idea, a single Y the reader leaves with.
  5. Draft — against the checklist (archive-led opening, compression point, return structure).
  6. AI-marker + vague-word sweep — kill the empty, the corporate, the substitutable.
  7. Where this came from — a reader-facing grouped-citations close; a shopping cart for gaps.
  8. The lens — a witnessing-I closing note, added last: her angle of regard, not memoir.

apparatus.title: The method apparatus — what governs the writing
apparatus.what: the locked craft rules the pipeline runs on
body:
• Voice guide — the binding register + sentence craft (voice_guide.md).
  • The lens / witnessing-I — the last-step closing note; her angle of regard, bottom-placed.
  • Associative signature — the leap (parable → children's book → life) as her native cognition.
  • Confession discipline — magnitude-not-arrival; both-not-instead (hold the surface motive).
  • The multi-lens battery + 3-prong pipeline — theology → grammar → garden.
  • Frame sweep + parity fan-out — force the five blind spots; surface Global-South voices.
  • Citation standard — curatorial 'Where this came from' + the library-tie (a cited work we don't hold is an acquisition target); SBL deferred to the thesis.
  • Authored design / AI-disclosure — the process made legible as a claim, not an apology.

scripts.title: The tooling
scripts.what: the scripts + skills the workstream runs on
body:
• /grammar — the seed-to-draft skill (.claude/commands/grammar.md): the 8-step pipeline, the reference-pack harvest, the parity fan-out + frame sweep, the bug-screens.
  • Frame-sweep checklist — drafts/grammar_of_meaning/_FRAME_SWEEP_CHECKLIST.md.
  • build_essays.py (deploy repo) — mirrors the published Substack essays into house-styled reader pages (Substack = source of truth).
  • This exporter — scripts/analysis/export_essay_workstream.py — regenerates this registry so the SSOT page never goes stale.

handover.title: Handover — for a future essay-SB
handover.what: how to pick up the workstream without archaeology
body:
1. This page (the SSOT) + field_ed/_essay_workstream/EWS_STATE.md (the work-state).
  2. The voice guide + one canon essay; then the /grammar skill.
  3. The seed index (what's waiting) + the essay-revision workbook + consistency audit.

Non-negotiables: first-person-about-the-third; curatorial register; the lens is added LAST; count-free durable prose (numbers are generated, never typed); every claim cites a real source, and a source we don't hold becomes an acquisition target (the Librarian).
